title: God Is Near in the Valley
description: Psalm 23:4 speaks to the seasons when the way ahead feels dark. David reminds us that God's presence brings courage and comfort even when the valley remains.
opening_reflection: Some valleys feel dark because we cannot see ahead. But the Shepherd does not leave us.
reflection: The valley may remain, but we do not walk through it alone. The Lord is with us.
prayer: Lord, when the way feels dark, help me trust that You are near. Amen.
caption: Psalm 23:4
